guidance.summary: Project guidance requires scoped edits and current verification evidence.

baseline_facts.fact: The project already exposes command-line subcommands from src/cli.py.
Command tests use the standard-library unittest runner.

constraints: Do not add a runtime dependency.

objective.summary: Add a read-only health-check command that reports whether local configuration can be loaded.
objective.user_value: Maintainers can diagnose configuration problems before starting the service.
success_outcomes: The command returns a successful status for valid local configuration.
The command returns a nonzero status and a concise diagnostic for invalid configuration.

in_scope: Add the health-check command to the existing dispatcher.
Add focused success and failure tests.
Document the new command in the existing command reference.
out_of_scope: Start the service or contact an external endpoint.
scope.execution_authority: This plan records and tracks proposed work. Creating or approving it does not authorize implementation, installation, publication, deployment, or another separately governed action.

sources.title: Health-check planning request
facts_used: The command must not change project state.
The user approved using the existing command dispatcher and standard-library test runner.

requirements.title: Provide a read-only health check
requirements.outcome: The command reports whether local configuration can be loaded without changing project or external state.
requirements.intent: Maintainers need a safe diagnostic before service startup.
acceptance_criteria: Valid configuration produces exit status 0 and a concise success result.
Invalid configuration produces a nonzero exit status and a diagnostic that does not expose secrets.
The command does not write project files or contact an external service.
negative_requirements: The command must not modify configuration.

decisions.statement: Use the existing command dispatcher and standard-library test runner.
decisions.authority_basis: The current user explicitly approved these project-fitting implementation constraints in the source request.

phases.title: Implement and verify the health check
phases.objective: Deliver the bounded command, focused tests, and command documentation.
entry_conditions: The exact implementation plan is approved and implementation is separately authorized.
exit_criteria: All phase tasks meet their acceptance criteria with current evidence.
risks: Diagnostics could expose configuration values; tests and review must verify redaction.

tasks.title: Implement the read-only command
tasks.action: Add the health-check route through the existing dispatcher and reuse the current configuration loader without writing state.
risks: An exception path could include a configuration value.
acceptance_criteria: The route reports valid and invalid configuration with the required exit statuses.
No command path writes configuration or contacts an external service.
verification_steps: Inspect the implementation path for writes and network calls.

tasks.title: Test and document the command
tasks.action: Add focused success, failure, redaction, and no-write checks, then update the existing command reference.
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests cover both exit paths, redaction, and the no-write boundary.
The existing command reference explains the new route and its exit behavior.
verification_steps: Resolve documentation links and compare command syntax with helper output.
